preconditions.description: The number of past olympiads, cities, and queries are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= m for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list of past host cities has length n and each city index is valid.

preconditions.expression: len(k_list) == q and all(n + 1 <= k <= 10**18 for k in k_list)
preconditions.description: The list of query years has length q and each year is strictly greater than n and within the upper bound.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= m for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line represents a valid city index between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: all(city_at_year(k_list[i], initial_counts) == int(output_lines[i]) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output is the city that hosts the olympiad in year k_i, determined by the rule: select the city with the minimum total hosting count (initial + subsequent), breaking ties by smallest index.
